part.text:
Fixed in `caddyconfig/caddyfile/lexer.go` (caddyconfig/caddyfile/lexer.go:694). The heredoc lexer now:

- Ends the token normally when a space follows `<<` (so `between << >>` lexes as regular tokens `<<` and `>>` instead of failing).
- Skips heredoc detection inside quoted/backquoted tokens (so `"<<"` works).
- Moves the "too many `<`" check to the newline branch so `<<<EOF` as a plain token is valid, and errors on an empty marker after `<<`.

Verified: `go test ./caddyconfig/caddyfile/...` passes (all lexer/parser tests, including the new heredoc cases), and the exact Caddyfile from the issue now tokenizes to `between`, `<<`, `>>` without error.
